Common.cache_name sanitizes dash/dot/space to underscore, removes slash and lowercases, then joins fields with underscores. Distinct resource names or vhost/name boundaries can alias; no live broker contamination claim.
Exchange.validate longstr branches accept any Integer.parse result other than :error, including nonpositive values or parsed-prefix suffixes; Common.rabbit_argument later calls String.to_integer.
Exchange route? Cache.insert case covers only inserted/exists and not error; queue duplicate? extracts elem(1) of Cache.exists? without error discriminant.
Cache @options excludes persistence although exchange reset/policy handlers call Cache.option(cache,:persistence,...); errors/results are not propagated.
Cache.delete_expired_entries selects expired keys in one transaction then deletes them in a separate transaction; refresh races require real Mnesia testing.
